sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: In the story 'The Crow', what did the thirsty crow find?
options: B) A pitcher with a little water
questions.answer: B) A pitcher with a little water

questions.question_text: Choose the correct article: I saw ___ eagle flying high in the sky.
According to the poem 'My Bicycle', what sound does the bicycle bell make?
Choose the correct pronoun: Rohan and I are friends. ___ are going to the park.
In 'A Show of Clouds', what shapes can we sometimes see in the sky?
Choose the correct present continuous verb: The little boy is ___ an apple.
From the chapter 'We are all Indians', which of these is our National Flower?
Choose the correct conjunction: I want to play outside, ___ it is raining.
In 'The Smart Monkey', who wanted to eat the monkey's heart?
Choose the correct preposition: The dog is sleeping ___ the table.
Name two places you might see on the route 'Between Home and School'. (Write 1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: On my way to school, I see a beautiful park and a big post office.

questions.question_text: How can we know if a cup of milk is hot without looking at it? (Write 1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: We can know if the cup is hot by gently touching it with our hands.

questions.question_text: According to the poem, what do 'Little Drops of Water' and little grains of sand make? (Write 1 sentence)
questions.answer: Little drops of water make the mighty ocean, and little grains of sand make the beauteous land.

questions.question_text: Why do people write letters to their family members who live far away? (Write 1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: People write letters to share their feelings, tell them about their day, and say that they miss them.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence using proper punctuation and capital letters: my name is rita and i live in delhi
questions.answer: My name is Rita and I live in Delhi.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct action word (swims, fly, read, cooks, jumps): 1. The fish ___ in the pond. 2. The birds ___ in the blue sky. 3. I ___ a storybook every night. 4. My father ___ delicious food. 5. The frog ___ on the green leaf.
Match the Common Noun to the correct Proper Noun: (1) Boy, (2) City, (3) Day, (4) River, (5) Festival. Options to match: (a) Diwali, (b) Rohan, (c) Ganga, (d) Mumbai, (e) Monday.
questions.answer: (1) Boy - (b) Rohan, (2) City - (d) Mumbai, (3) Day - (e) Monday, (4) River - (c) Ganga, (5) Festival - (a) Diwali.

questions.question_text: Imagine you have a magical bicycle that can go anywhere. Where would you ride it and what would you see? Write 3 sentences.
questions.answer: I would ride my magical bicycle high up into the sky. I would pedal through the fluffy white clouds and touch a rainbow. I would see beautiful birds flying right next to me.

questions.question_text: Think of a community helper in your town (like a doctor, teacher, or police officer). Write 2-3 sentences describing how they help us every day.
questions.answer: A doctor is a very helpful person in my town. When we fall sick or get hurt, the doctor gives us medicine to make us feel better. They work hard in the hospital to keep everyone healthy.
